profile.summary: Open'Hood is a nonprofit that produces documentary films and digital storytelling projects. Its work explores large social issues through character-driven nonfiction stories, with a focus on Oakland, California communities.

review.notes: Open'Hood (openhood.org) is an Oakland-focused documentary nonprofit, matching the Filming Access Agreement and the 501(c)(3) Openhood Inc, EIN 26-4312908 (ProPublica). The summary, orgType, website and EIN are supported; headquarters is not, since the about page only says its work centers on Oakland communities and ProPublica lists a Piedmont, CA address.
